text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on the west side of Avonlea Boulevard, in front of the pathways to Maryland Park, between Dentonia Park Avenue and Coleman Avenue. The proposed changes will facilitate safe movement of pedestrians to and from the pathways that connect with Maryland Park.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times, on the west side of Avonlea Boulevard, between Dentonia Park Avenue (north intersection) and a point 49.4 metres further south; between a point 30 metres south of Dentonia Park Avenue (south intersection) and a point 8 metres further south; and a point 59 metres south of Dentonia Park Avenue (south intersection) and a point 6 meters further south.
